name: Tractogram cleaning with DIPY's quickBundles
summary: Removes spurious streamlines from a .tck tractogram by clustering it with DIPY QuickBundlesX and culling streamlines in small clusters, also splitting an optional white matter classification.
description: Clusters the whole-brain tractogram with dipy.segment.bundles.qbx_and_merge and keeps only streamlines in clusters with more than streamThresh members; the rest are written to a separate culled tractogram. If a white matter classification is supplied, its labels are split to match the surviving and culled streamlines. Use it as a quick outlier-removal step after tractography. The README is an unfilled template, and qbThreshes is parsed but not passed to the clustering, which always uses thresholds 30, 20, 10, 5 mm.

inputs.description: A whole brain tractogram that is to be subjected to a cull of extraneous or otherwise spurious streamlines
Optional white matter classification (classification.mat) indexing the tractogram's streamlines; its labels are carried over to the surviving and culled outputs.

outputs.description: The output tractogram which has had some number of spurious or extraneous streamlines removed.
A WMC corresponding to the surviving streamlines.   Identities passed through if WMC input provided, otherwise ignore.
A tractogram containing the streamlines that were culled
A WMC corresponding to the culled streamlines.   Identities passed through if WMC input provided, otherwise ignore.

parameters.description: The minimum streamlines (and thus an **integer**) needed in a quickBundles cluster in order to survive the culling process.
Comma-separated QuickBundlesX distance thresholds; parsed by the code but not passed to qbx_and_merge, so the defaults 30,20,10,5 are always used.
